refusal_rule: a methodological failure is not a scientific null. A refused experiment leaves its hypothesis untested, not refuted, and closes nothing downstream
binding_rule: a null is immutable. It may be superseded only by an appended authority that states the new evidence, never by rewriting or relabelling the original
closure_rule: a failed branch closes only its own descendants, never an independent branch
